rankings.good: JT and Saquon are still JT and Saquon, and Shough has been a real QB. Lost the last one by 3.
rankings.bad: AJ Brown on IR, Jacobs still waiting on a suspension, Kyler and Darnold useless. 0-3 with a roster that's basically a hospital. Hole might already be too deep.

rankings.good: Puka comes back in a few weeks and Geno's been a solid fill in. Two of the three losses were close. Healthy, this is still one of the most talented rosters in the league.
rankings.bad: 0-3 with Achane on IR, Etienne out and Caleb doubtful. By the time Puka's back it might be too late.

rankings.good: Chase, Hurts and Maye can all go off any given week, and the receivers finally showed up.
rankings.bad: Maye went negative, Loveland has 8 points in 3 weeks and he's made 1 waiver move all year. Bench is thin and he's not going to fix it.

rankings.good: Bowers is back, CeeDee and Watson are both producing and Jeremiyah Love is starting to look like a first rounder. Daniels is back in a few weeks.
rankings.bad: Dart's done for the year and until Daniels is back the QBs are Penix, Cam Ward and Mariota. The OP slot is a coin flip every week.

rankings.good: 3rd most points in the league. ARSB, Olave, Stafford, CMC, Kittle. The points are there, the wins will follow.
rankings.bad: 1-2 and CMC and Kittle aren't getting any younger. If one of them goes down it's Tuten and Hunter Henry.

rankings.good: Bijan is cooking, 2nd in the NFL in rushing, and Nix has been steady. Two straight wins and the schedule's turning.
rankings.bad: Baker and Tyreek both out, Nabers hasn't done anything and Hampton keeps disappearing. QB2 is Deshaun Watson until Baker's back.

rankings.good: Gibbs, London and Burrow all clicked at the same time, and he's got two QBs who can drop 30. Darnold on the bench as insurance.
rankings.bad: RB2 is still Rhamondre, and Zay and DJ Moore are banged up. The flex is held together with tape.

rankings.good: Allen and Henry is still the best 1-2 in the league and the bench is stacked with RBs. He's going to put up points every week.
rankings.bad: WRs are a 33 year old Davante and McConkey, TE is Kincaid. One bad Allen week and he loses, like this week.

rankings.good: Purdy and Lamar is the best QB duo in the league when they're both healthy, and K9 leads the NFL in rushing. That floor is real.
rankings.bad: JJ and T-Mac have been invisible, Breece is doubtful and Lamar's questionable. Two of the three wins were by single digits. Living on the edge.

rankings.good: Deepest team in the league. JSN, Cook, Jeanty and two QBs who drop 3 TDs a week, plus Kamara sitting on the bench as insurance. Nobody's catching him anytime soon.
rankings.bad: Nico keeps popping up hurt and the TE is Tucker Kraft off an ACL. One RB injury and it gets thin fast. Champs always catch the regression bug at some point.
